tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Main content area: chat log, settings pages.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Primary navigation column. One step darker than bg in dark, one step greyer in light.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Secondary columns (members, conversations) and settings section cards.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Hovered message rows, banners, inputs placed on panel, media placeholders.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for navigation and list rows.

tokens.name: hover-2
tokens.usage: Hover fill for icon buttons and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, composer, popovers, the floating save bar.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Current navigation item, pressed toggles, role badges.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Background of segmented controls.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Selected segment inside a segmented control, on track.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Column dividers, card outlines, header rules. Structure only, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and composer outlines, popover edges.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Rules between rows inside a settings section.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Switch track when off, secondary button outlines. Decorative: the knob position and the label carry the state, the button text carries the action.

tokens.name: control-strong
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio outlines, where the outline is the only cue. At least 3:1 on bg and panel in both themes.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Switch knob in the off state.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Names, headings, labels on bg, sidebar, panel, subtle and raised.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Message bodies and long copy on bg and subtle.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, inactive navigation, icon buttons on every surface.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Timestamps, hints, section labels. At least 4.5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember. Fills only: primary buttons, unread counts, the switch on state, brand mark. Never as text on light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Ember is too light for white text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or icon: mentions, inline links, pinned icon. Darkened in light for 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a message that mentions you and of the mention chip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions as text: Block, Log out, Close group. Always paired with a verb.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon in banners. The banner text carries the meaning.

tokens.name: status-online
tokens.usage: Presence dot for online. Always backed by a text label nearby.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Presence dot for idle.

tokens.name: status-offline
tokens.usage: Presence dot for offline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Known issue on server s12, reconnecting twice usually sticks.
styles.usage: Messages, labels, list rows. The default.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Shows a short popup instead of the badge.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Sidebar and member section labels, written in capitals in the copy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges, between stacked label lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label, between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Avatar to message gap, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile, header gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Message log side padding, settings row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between settings sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap before a new page block.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Settings page top padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Settings page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Role badges, kbd hints, mention chip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, icon buttons, segments.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Settings sections, composer, cards, save bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, presence dots, count badges, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Message action toolbar, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Save bar, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside cards and toolbars.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, list rows, inputs on desktop.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on login and dialogs.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum target on mobile.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Primary navigation width.

tokens.name: size-members
tokens.usage: Members and profile column width.
